detail.zh: 加密保存秘密，Workers 使用工作区/项目引用；不是 Supabase Postgres Vault 扩展或相同函数接口。
detail.en: Encrypted W-ID secrets and project/workspace references exist; this differs from the Supabase Postgres Vault extension.

feature.zh: 注册邮件 OTP / 会话

detail.zh: signup 验证、单次刷新、项目范围 local/others/global 注销已覆盖；非 signup OTP 不在矩阵中。
detail.en: Signup verification, single-use refresh and project-scoped logout are covered; other OTP types are outside the matrix.

feature.zh: 匿名登录 / service-role 管理

detail.zh: 当前 GoTrue 矩阵明确不支持匿名登录与浏览器 admin/service-role；原生服务端管理是另一接口。
detail.en: The GoTrue matrix excludes anonymous signin and browser admin/service-role; native server administration is a separate API.

feature.zh: 签名下载 / 上传链接

detail.zh: 读链接最长一小时、批量最多 100 项；上传授权两小时、绑定精确对象。签发 key 撤销不撤销已签发上传授权。
detail.en: Reads last up to one hour / 100 batch items; uploads last two hours and bind an exact object. Issuer-key revocation does not revoke existing upload grants.

feature.zh: 桶策略 / 配额 / 归档删除

detail.zh: 支持 MIME/大小、配额、归档恢复与精确删除；通用 S3 全写入配额、永久清除和生命周期有明确限制。
detail.en: MIME/size, quotas, archive/restore and exact deletion exist; generic-S3 all-write quotas, permanent purge and lifecycle have explicit limits.

feature.zh: 函数版本 / 回滚 / 删除

detail.zh: 真实身份组合完成 v1→v2→v1、撤销拒绝和删除；原生历史保留 deleted 状态，生产普通用户同路径待验证。
detail.en: Real-identity composition passed v1/v2/rollback, revocation and deletion; native history retains deleted records, and ordinary-user production E2E is pending.

feature.zh: 数据库时间点恢复 PITR

detail.zh: 提供方能力未支持时明确 false；pg_dump/pg_restore 不能算 WAL 时间点恢复。
detail.en: Provider capability remains false where unsupported; dump/restore is not WAL point-in-time recovery.

detail.zh: 有真实 KVM、不变镜像与签名回执执行；运行时不是 workerd，完整 Web/Node API 对等未证明。
detail.en: Real KVM, immutable images and signed execution receipts are proven; runtime is not workerd and full Web/Node API parity is not claimed.

feature.zh: 源码版本 / 构建产物

detail.zh: 不可变源码、包摘要、JS/TS 语义检查与运行 bundle 有契约；构建成功不自动等于已部署。
detail.en: Immutable sources, checksummed bundles and JS/TS semantic checks exist; packaging is distinct from deployment.

detail.zh: 版本必须取得签名 applied 回执；真实组件通过 v1/v2/回滚，线上用户全链路待验收。
detail.en: Versions require signed applied receipts; real-component v1/v2/rollback passed, ordinary-user production E2E remains.

detail.zh: 支持一个版本或两个版本精确权重；完整多版本、生产流量分布与故障回滚未专项验收。
detail.en: One or two versions with exact weights are supported; broader traffic distribution and production failure rollback are unproven.

feature.zh: 公开 / JWT 保护调用

detail.zh: 公开调用可显式选择，保护调用使用实时精确项目用户授权；开发管理权限与终端用户分开。
detail.en: Public invocation is explicit; protected calls use live exact-project user authorization, separate from developer management rights.

detail.zh: 字符串 vars 与不可变版本快照已覆盖；JSON vars、额外供应商 binding 和并发 CAS 未齐。
detail.en: String vars and immutable version snapshots are covered; JSON vars, other vendor bindings and concurrent CAS are not.

detail.zh: 支持加密项目级秘密引用与轮换；不是 per-Worker secret 命名空间，原生命令 secret * 明确不支持。
detail.en: Encrypted project secret references and rotation exist; per-Worker secret namespaces and secret * commands are not supported.

detail.zh: 支持项目桶授权与对象适配；不能据此宣称完整 R2 binding API。
detail.en: Project bucket grants/object adapters exist; full R2 binding API compatibility is not claimed.

detail.zh: 支持 name/main/date/string vars/env；TOML、assets、build、routes、compatibility_flags 和额外绑定拒绝。
detail.en: Supports name/main/date/string vars/env; TOML, assets, build, routes, compatibility_flags and extra bindings are rejected.

detail.zh: 命名 Worker 与变量隔离；项目秘密仍共享，不等于独立项目/租户/完整生产预览环境。
detail.en: Worker names/vars separate environments; project secrets stay shared and this is not independent project/tenant/preview parity.

detail.zh: 兼容矩阵明确不支持 dev；本地静态服务不能冒充 Workers 开发环境。
detail.en: Compatibility matrices explicitly exclude dev; static serving is not a Workers dev environment.

detail.zh: 提供有界日志快照，不支持 Wrangler 实时 tail 流。
detail.en: Bounded log snapshots exist, but Wrangler live tail streaming is unsupported.

detail.zh: 真实 Worker 执行已有签名日志与 metrics；完整 Logpush/尾流/供应商观测 API 未齐。
detail.en: Real Worker execution has signed logs and metrics; full Logpush/tail/vendor observability API parity is absent.

detail.zh: 终止运行后删除确切 Worker 记录，保留邻居资源；真实组合与生产 facade 的清理有证据。
detail.en: Terminates then deletes the exact Worker while preserving neighbors; composition and production facade cleanup are proven.

detail.zh: 不自动识别框架或执行构建，也不导入 Worker static assets 配置。
detail.en: No framework detection/build execution or Worker static-assets config import.

detail.zh: 日期与部分 node: 导入经过编译验证；不是所有 Cloudflare 日期语义或 Node 内置 API。
detail.en: Dates and selected node: imports are compiler-validated, not all Cloudflare date semantics or Node builtins.

detail.zh: 目录上传、二进制资产、首次发布和不可变版本有门槛；框架自动构建与全托管 Git 工作流未齐。
detail.en: Directory/binary uploads, first publication and immutable versions have gates; automatic framework/Git workflows are not proven.

detail.zh: 支持版本列表和子域名模式预览；path-prefix 模式预览明确 501，只有 production 环境。
detail.en: Version listing and subdomain previews exist; path-prefix previews return 501 and only production environment exists.

detail.zh: 历史内容重新发布为新版本，保留旧版本不变；生产域名回滚仍需专项证明。
detail.en: Historical content is republished as a new version while old versions stay immutable; production domain rollback needs evidence.

feature.zh: 自定义域名 / DNS 证明

detail.zh: 有域名添加、TXT 验证、删除契约；终端用户生产 DNS/TLS/撤销及回滚未完整验收。
detail.en: Add/TXT verification/removal contracts exist; user production DNS/TLS/revocation/rollback remain unverified.

detail.zh: 没有 Pages Functions 同构运行时；pages dev 与 Pages secrets 命令明确不支持。
detail.en: No equivalent Pages Functions runtime; pages dev and Pages-specific secrets are explicitly unsupported.

feature.zh: Git 自动构建 / 分支预览

detail.zh: 已有静态发布不证明 Git webhook、自动构建及分支预览完整工作流。
detail.en: Static publication does not prove Git webhooks, automated builds or branch preview workflows.

detail.zh: 支持项目私有桶列表/创建/读取/删除；真实 W-ID 的 native CLI 测试仅证明本地 Objects 适配。
detail.en: Project private-bucket CRUD exists; real-W-ID native CLI acceptance proves the local Objects adapter, not production upstream.

feature.zh: 对象读写 / 范围 / 条件

detail.zh: S3/Storage 有读写、分页、范围和条件读取；Wrangler 只映射对象基础命令。
detail.en: S3/Storage supports CRUD, paging, ranges and conditional reads; Wrangler maps only basic object commands.

detail.zh: 原生 S3 面支持 multipart；Wrangler R2 高级 multipart 参数不支持。
detail.en: Native S3 supports multipart; advanced Wrangler R2 multipart options are unsupported.

detail.zh: Wrangler 桶能力只声明私有项目桶；不声称公开桶及公开 R2 域名语义。
detail.en: Wrangler bucket capability is private-project only; public buckets/R2 domains are not claimed.

detail.zh: 本地存储支持生命周期/版本；通用 S3 生命周期和跨提供方版本/删除标记仍有限制。
detail.en: Local lifecycle/versioning exists; generic-S3 lifecycle and portable versions/delete markers remain limited.

detail.zh: 通用 S3 适配器实测 MinIO，可配置 R2；未取得真实 R2 生产读写/故障专项证据。
detail.en: Generic S3 was tested against MinIO and can target R2; actual production R2 I/O/failure acceptance was not found.

feature.zh: 复制 / 提供方故障转移

detail.zh: 兼容契约明确保留跨提供方复制/故障转移门槛，当前不能标记完成。
detail.en: The compatibility contract retains cross-provider replication/failover gates; completion is not established.

detail.zh: W-Drop/w-cli 明确拒绝 kv 命令；数据库表不能改名冒充 KV。
detail.en: W-Drop/w-cli explicitly reject kv commands; database tables are not a KV compatibility implementation.

detail.zh: W-Drop/w-cli 明确拒绝 d1 命令；PostgreSQL 不等于 D1 SQLite API。
detail.en: W-Drop/w-cli explicitly reject d1 commands; PostgreSQL is not the D1 SQLite API.

detail.zh: 不在本轮已交付兼容能力内；同类 W 产品或内部后台不能替代此项 API、运行时及生产验收。
detail.en: Outside this delivered compatibility scope; similar W products/internal systems do not establish API, runtime or production parity.

detail.zh: 平台域名与路由已注册；客户域名全套 DNS API、传播一致性与权限仍需专项对比。
detail.en: Platform domains/routes are registered; customer DNS API, propagation and permission parity require separate checks.

detail.zh: 当前公开健康检查使用可信 TLS；Caddy 是实际证书所有者，不是 Cloudflare SSL API 实现。
detail.en: Current public health uses trusted TLS; Caddy owns certificates and does not implement the Cloudflare SSL API.

detail.zh: 使用 Cloudflare 公共入口不等于自有全球 CDN；多 POP 缓存一致性、调度、故障恢复未证明。
detail.en: Using Cloudflare ingress does not establish an independently owned global CDN; POP consistency/routing/recovery are unproven.

detail.zh: 已有静态分发不代表完整缓存规则、Cache API 或全局 purge 语义；需要独立契约。
detail.en: Static distribution does not prove full cache rules, Cache API or global purge semantics.

feature.zh: 流量调度 / 跨节点恢复

detail.zh: 当前路由与回滚准备有证据；真实负载均衡、跨节点恢复、持续容量与 SLO 未验收。
detail.en: Routes and rollback preparation are evidenced; live load balancing, cross-node recovery, sustained capacity and SLOs are not.

detail.zh: 存在模型网关项目；与 Cloudflare AI Gateway 的缓存、限流、分析和供应商功能对等未专项验收。
detail.en: Model gateway projects exist; Cloudflare AI Gateway caching, limits, analytics and provider parity are unverified.

feature.zh: 统一身份 / 项目发现

detail.zh: 三方发现中的 workspace/project 与原生 Functions/Workers 所有权一致；当前只读脚本 11/11 通过。
detail.en: Workspace/project and native Functions/Workers ownership agree across discovery; current read-only probes passed 11/11.

detail.zh: Radar 当前 pin：W-ID 1.3.49、DB 0.8.21、Storage 0.1.7、Drop 0.4.0、Sandbox 0.2.0；发布 CI 与此前进程哈希有记录。
detail.en: Radar pins W-ID 1.3.49, DB 0.8.21, Storage 0.1.7, Drop 0.4.0 and Sandbox 0.2.0; release CI and earlier process hashes are recorded.

feature.zh: 普通新用户完整生产流程

detail.zh: Auth→CRUD/RLS→私有 Storage→Realtime→保护函数/Worker→日志→备份恢复→撤销回滚→清理尚无完整线上成功记录。
detail.en: No complete online fresh-user Auth→CRUD/RLS→Storage→Realtime→Functions/Workers→logs→backup/restore→revocation/rollback→cleanup success record.

feature.zh: 同项目双函数运行时生产验收

detail.zh: 真实身份隔离组合生命周期通过；生产 Sandbox KVM 也实测，但不能合并为普通用户经公开 Drop/native API 的全流程。
detail.en: Real-identity composition passed and production Sandbox KVM was separately tested; together these do not prove ordinary-user public API E2E.

detail.zh: 公开入口有正常 W-ID 登录跳转；本地浏览器通过不等于当前生产回调及登录后业务已全验收。
detail.en: Public entry follows W-ID login redirects; local browser passes do not prove current production callback/post-login business flows.

feature.zh: 租户拒绝 / 真实撤销

detail.zh: 真实组件组合证明外租户、平台非成员和 OAuth 撤销拒绝；公开生产全链路仍需同项复验。
detail.en: Real-component composition proves foreign-tenant/nonmember denials and OAuth revocation; production E2E needs the same checks.

feature.zh: 不可变 Worker / 签名 / 清理

detail.zh: 生产实际 KVM、镜像/来宾哈希、独立签名验证和删除清理有证据；不能扩展为整个终端用户 Worker 发布链路。
detail.en: Production KVM, image/guest hashes, independent signatures and deletion cleanup are proven, not the entire end-user deployment chain.

detail.zh: 健康绿灯、CI 与静态哈希都不能替代负载、跨节点故障、RPO/RTO 或灾备演练。
detail.en: Health, CI and file hashes do not establish load, cross-node failure, RPO/RTO or disaster-recovery acceptance.
